title: "Agentic AI: Autonomy in Action!"
description: Agentic AI refers to autonomous intelligence systems built to make decisions, adapt to environments, and achieve specific goals with minimal human intervention, distinguishing itself from Generative AI by focusing on independence rather than content creation. While Agentic AI has widespread applications in fields like customer service, healthcare, and cybersecurity, challenges include ethical concerns, complex deployment, and high costs of integration.
